summary: Comprehensive plan to extract and curate authentic, high-resolution botanical photography from the Bangladesh Forest Department (BFIS), Bangladesh National Herbarium (BNH), Flora of Bangladesh, and Wikimedia Commons. The plan enriches all 55 catalog tree species and key ecosystem anchors (Sundari, Sal, Golpata, Jackfruit, Mango, Sundarbans, and Madhupur) with verified habit covers, morphological plates (leaves, bark, flowers, fruits), and trusted source badges.
